what: Circular info board — event info (date, time, place, price, tickets) wraps as text around five concentric rings, and each ring spins endlessly in alternating directions without curves. One turn takes 20, 16.7, 13.3, 10 and 6.7s from the inside out, so outer rings are faster. The event name sits in the center

options.durs: Length of one turn per ring (seconds), from the inside, comma-separated, default 20,16.7,13.3,10,6.7 — if there are more rings, the last value is reused
options.dir: Inner ring direction — -1 counterclockwise (default)·1 clockwise, alternating outward
options.origin: Axis it rotates around (SVG coordinates "x y"), default viewBox centered

note: Text sits on each ring’s circular path via textPath. With a reduced-motion setting it does not rotate

from.where: index.html .mt-ring (night·day cell event info concentric circles)
